disclaimer: Educational prototype; not clinician reviewed. Terrestrial source guidance is not validated for space. No diagnosis, treatment or readiness clearance.
urgent_help: Alert the onboard medical officer / crew now and use the established emergency procedure. Do not wait for the simulated Earth link. For an actual desktop emergency, seek local emergency assistance now. This mission routing is a project adaptation, not a NASA-approved protocol.

sources.title: NASA remote health monitoring research
sources.summary: Remote health monitoring motivates this project; NASA context does not validate its symptom guidance.

sources.title: NHS Headaches
sources.summary: Warning examples inform the questions; the screen is not exhaustive. Record the pattern and seek medical review for concerning or recurring symptoms.

sources.title: NHS Shortness of breath
sources.summary: Severe breathing symptoms and accompanying chest or awareness changes need urgent help.

sources.title: NHS Tiredness and fatigue
sources.role: terrestrial symptom background; review due passed
sources.summary: Persistent or unexplained fatigue and effects on daily life warrant clinical review; record sleep context.

sources.title: FDA Pulse Oximeter Basics
sources.summary: Consider symptoms alongside readings. Accuracy can vary, including with skin pigmentation. This demo has no connected oximeter.

questions.text: Severe trouble breathing, chest tightness/heaviness or pain spreading to arm/back/neck/jaw, blue/grey/very pale appearance, or sudden confusion?

Abrupt extreme headache; new weakness, speech/balance change, confusion/drowsiness, seizure or lost vision; recent head injury; or very high temperature, stiff neck, marked light sensitivity, or concerning rash?
Vision/eye problems, vomiting, pain worse with exertion, jaw/scalp symptoms, or headache persisting, worsening or recurring?

steps.text: Record headache timing, changes and associated symptoms in a diary for medical review.
Reduce prolonged screen strain where feasible; record what changed.

questions.text: Severe trouble breathing, chest tightness/heaviness or pain spreading to arm/back/neck/jaw, blue/grey/very pale appearance, or sudden confusion?
Is tiredness unexplained or persistent, affecting daily tasks, or accompanied by other symptoms?

steps.text: Record sleep timing, duration and disruptions as a diary, not inferred sleep stages.
Record whether a consistent sleep schedule and a quieter sleep setting are feasible.
If useful, record the optional laptop reaction check as task evidence only; it cannot explain fatigue or establish fitness.

questions.text: Severe trouble breathing, chest tightness/heaviness or pain spreading to arm/back/neck/jaw, blue/grey/very pale appearance, or sudden confusion?
Does the reading itself concern you, or are symptoms concerning or worsening?
Is an external measurement device available, with its instructions?

steps.text: Record unavailable when there is no device; never invent a reading. Otherwise record device, acquisition time and symptoms.
For an available external oximeter, follow its instructions, keep movement low and wait for a stable display; record a repeat for review.
If a source waveform exists, open technical signal review and record a recheck request; model scores never determine clinical urgency.
